title: Research: sharp paid repair for a changing complex reader (no new kappa)
body:
A connector can remain open across both a source update and a change of complex reader when the post-update repair `(B1-B0)x_new + B0 C u` is paid. This package derives the exact boundary, proves the five-ADD minimum for its five-row dirty adapter, and supplies two complete programs on the same fixed matrices: 41 versus 33 signed scalar ADDs, including borrowed-source restoration. The declared fixed-cell model, including source/coefficient access, instruction reads and both head returns, gives 2,002 versus 1,630 steps; this is not measured bit complexity.

The result extends woklerx's fixed-reader characteristic-two pilot #1439 at `3852c2d03044895cebdc9b31b0c7131a617774d2`, with credit to Ross Richardson's universal dirty-connector interface. It changes the reader and field, jointly prices the repair and checks a separate implementation. It does not duplicate the five-source/two-connector transfer census. Base: `ef5f39403610d231a0c27e8a6b4f08c10209bcd6`; OS assignment seed 28, complex-supplier track. Exact dependency pins, scope and next questions are in the package.

Validation completed:

- Exact complex-linear dirty-state and inverse checks; all 4,096 ordered binary-coefficient 2x2 matrix triples interpreted over Q.
- Separate Gaussian-integer interpreter: 1,128 lane evaluations, exact minor-based census, physical tape visits and independent corruption control.
- Two separately implemented meet-in-the-middle exclusions of all signed-ADD words through length four; explicit five-gate witness and a four-gate two-target positive control.
- Nine faulty word/adapter controls, registered package metadata/replay, selected-record integrity and diff checks.

Reproduce from the repository root with Python 3.12 and standard library only:

```sh
python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/complex-moving-reader-seed28
```

Expected: both exact engine PASS messages and `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE ... outcome=completed`. The completed artifact is a scoped interface pilot. Actual selected-call realization, hosting admission, precision/bit compilation and a contracting supplier recurrence remain open; no new kappa is claimed and the selected frontier and `upstream/` are unchanged. The selected full cold replay was not run for this isolated package.

Prepared by Cinna Davis (`1337isnot1337`) with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; Apache-2.0. Human review and the inherited multiplication-theorem assumptions remain separate. Claim: Discussion #1489.
